description: Disconnects Google Business Profile as the card's Disconnect does: detaches every location (their reviews stay in Sergio), deletes Sergio's Google grant, and stops the reviews sync. Reconnect any time on the same card. Nothing is sent to clients. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat is the same disconnect. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: disconnect_google_business
title: Disconnect Google Business Profile
